statusDefinitions.implemented_unverified: Code exists, but required tests/readback incomplete.
statusDefinitions.tested: All stated acceptance tests have evidence; distinguish source and physical runtime.
statusDefinitions.blocked: Dependency or objective failure prevents this task.

sourceOfTruth: Real runtime scene and existing editor transactions; no parallel simulated preview

gates.release: Only objective broken build, launch, essential gameplay, required multiplayer or updater function may block release. Art and diagnostics are advisory.
gates.security: Agent interfaces disabled by default, authenticated, loopback only, least privilege, no shell/filesystem access.
gates.completion: Do not count draft documentation, unpublished blobs, packaging, or missing real installed runtime as completed machine access.

tasks.name: Capture main SHA, current recovery gates, editor/portable tests and focused CI
accept: Exact-source SHA and linked workflow outcome
No-regression baseline recorded

tasks.name: In-process snapshot service for current live scene, objects, revisions, capabilities and assets
accept: Read same scene instance as GUI and game
Unsaved manual edit immediately visible through service
Stable IDs and consistent snapshot; no mutation API

tasks.name: Opt-in authenticated loopback GET protocol and shutdown lifecycle
accept: Only loopback bound and randomized bearer token
Auth and non-GET methods rejected
No listener after editor closes

tasks.name: Actual editor viewport capture and existing scene diagnostic output
accept: PNG originates from real runtime/editor renderer
Includes current scene revision and provenance
Audit warnings remain advisory

tasks.name: Windows running editor observation end-to-end and evidence record
accept: Live open editor, manual edit, remote-local readback and screenshot
Denied anonymous and mutation request tests
Saved test logs and commit SHA

tasks.name: Validated and version-checked editor commands with batch rollback
accept: One authoritative transaction and one undo event
Stale revision rejected and no scene change
Partial batch failure restores exact prior snapshot

tasks.name: Typed Castle commands: transform, props, lamps, surfaces, doors, spawn, nav
accept: Agent and human GUI observe identical result
Duplicate idempotency request makes no second object
Undo/redo and save/reload preserve scene

tasks.name: Readback proof, runtime capture, real collision/navigation/reference audit
accept: Return separately committed/saved/verified flags
Failures are structured, revisioned and truthful
Real engine-generated evidence; no source artwork substitute

tasks.name: Isolated playtest plus exact restoration of unsaved editor state
accept: Castle gameplay uses same authored data
Editor returns with unsaved edits intact
Real multiplayer host state unaffected

tasks.name: House and basement adapter fixture validations
accept: Only supported adapters are advertised
Door/opening collision and stair reachability proof
Measured render timing where available; no invented FPS

tasks.name: CLI and script execution against same Editor Agent Service
accept: No Swing dependency in headless service
Deterministic edit, readback, exit code and rollback
No fake viewport when renderer unavailable

tasks.name: Independent second Java 17 synthetic project adapter
accept: No Castle imports
Same protocol and error semantics
Save/reload deterministic

tasks.name: MCP tools/resources adapter mapping directly to service capabilities
accept: Tools are discoverable with typed schemas
Local authorization and capability-scoped writes
No remote shell, arbitrary files, or player-session access

tasks.name: Real installed editor agent repair demonstration
accept: Agent observes actual Castle scene
One reversible furnished-room/repair edit verified by readback
Actual screenshot and audit with source SHA and limitations

tasks.name: Second-game/module adapters after main editor acceptance
accept: Portable contracts prove independent game reuse
No implicit cross-repo migration

nextTask: T0 focused tests and T1 focused stitched-world acceptance; then T2 human-world editor

evidence.notes: Human module-first priority updated 2026-10-31. T0 and T1 have source commits; focused Windows acceptance still pending; all terrain rendering, streaming/LOD and agent-to-world connection unverified.
